scene: The pigeon drops three transit tickets onto a nearby departure desk.
picture: Side view of the treehouse transit platform. Far left, a red double-decker bus idle at an open doorway. Left, the boy in green stripes holding his board by a ticket desk. Centre, the roosting pigeon beside three tickets. Centre right, a paddle steamer docked at a gangway. Far right, a yellow skate shuttle.
